text.p: Enron Corp's Transwestern Pipeline Co said on Wednesday that it will provide additional natural gas capacity of 115 million cubic feet per day at its jointly owned pipeline that runs from Ignacio, Colo., through Blanco N.M.
Enron also wants to expand the pipeline from Blanco through Thoreau, N.M., by 130 million cubic feet of gas per day, it said.
The cost of the proposed expansion, which is expected to be in service by May 1, 1998, is expected to be $17.2 million, Enron said.
The pipeline's existing capacity from Ignacio to Blanco, N.M., is 276 million cubic feet per day and the pipeline from Ignacio to Thoreau is 775 million cubic feet per day, Enron said.
